name: UFC
short: UFC fight night: picture cards, tap-to-pick, live results, odds-based betting and standings.
description: Fight-card posters, Tale of the Tape and fighter cards from ESPN. Server pick'em with a tap-to-pick editor (winner + method/round bonus), fights that lock when their segment starts, bets paid at DraftKings odds, automatic live results and settling, card recaps, Discord scheduled events, and card/monthly/season leaderboards.
author: aKidWolfe
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores UFC picks (winner and optional method/round), wager amounts, and aggregate pick/betting statistics for Discord users in each server where it is used.
